name: Sniper (Combat)
body:
You are gifted at performing ranged ambushes.

Prerequisite: Stealth 5 ranks, Point-Blank Shot, Stealthy

Benefit: If you’ve already successfully used Stealth at least 10 feet from your target, you can make one ranged attack and then immediately use Stealth again. You take only a –10 penalty on your Stealth check to maintain your obscured location.
